summary: Glass House Brands filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian continuous-disclosure notice) disclosing an abrupt auditor change: BDO USA, P.C. resigned effective November 6, 2026 at the company's request after only two months, and predecessor Macias Gini & O'Connell LLP was reappointed. Audit committee and board approved. Notably, BDO resigned mid-review of the company's Q3 accounting for a June 2026 deconsolidation of Glass House Retail and had reached no conclusion; MGO previously reviewed the same transaction without modification. No transaction terms stated. Watch for restatement or disclosure risk.
